invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破81.5（基于ATR 0.768和日线支撑上移），或融资费率Z-score转正>50%（轧多风险增加）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 81.5 (based on ATR 0.768 and raised daily support), or funding Z-score turns positive >50% (long squeeze risk increases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2120（基于ATR 16.3129和支撑上移），或融资费率Z-score持续>150%（轧多风险极高）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2120 (based on ATR 16.3129 and raised support), or funding Z-score remains >150% (extremely high long squeeze risk).
